reason: Klaim lengkap mnemosyne-c01–c15 menyebut dewi memori/waktu, ibu Muses, oracle, sumur dan takhta, tetapi tidak mendokumentasikan tubuh, ikonografi, atau manifestasi aktif yang dapat mendominasi. Menggambar perempuan generik atau sumur saja akan mengarang wujud / gagal subjek.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: No image call made. Source fidelity takes priority; no body or active manifestation invented.
